Jason, saw Ambient.ai doubled new ARR in FY26 and signed a global reseller deal with Securitas.

Growth like that on strategic accounts usually means more in-market enterprises than your team can develop at once, and that is where pipeline goes cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up on its own, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Ambient.ai off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?

Jason, quick follow-up for Ambient.ai.

With ARR doubling and Securitas opening new reach, your strategic-account target climbs faster than the team can ramp, and most reps cannot say exactly how many meetings they need to hit it. The gap shows up late, and the quarter becomes a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Ambient.ai needs to close that gap this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.

Jason, last bit of proof for Ambient.ai.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Ambient.ai's reply rate likely compares to other high-growth B2B teams. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
